name: ugly-website-rebuild-outreach
description: the outreach system — find trade businesses with an outdated website, build a modern rebuild demo, CALL-FIRST to earn opt-in, then text the demo link, track, follow up, and close ($1,000 launch + $99/mo). Extends the live the existing stack (Close CRM + n8n); NEW dedicated Convex DB.

comments.scrape: Stage 1+2 lead finder → writes scraper/leads-*.csv (config in scraper/config.local.json).
comments.scrape:test: Verify the Google Places API key with a single call.
comments.generate: Per-lead demo builder (generator/premium/build-premium.js): deep-extract old site → AI photo gate → reskin premium template → deploy Vercel → Convex-native /r/ tracked link. Pass --lead-id <id> or --csv <file>. (The old generator/build-demo.js is superseded; its CLI is disabled.)
comments.import: Read the newest scraper/leads-*.csv and insert into the Convex leads table (dedupe by place_id, honor the channel gate). Pass a path to import a specific CSV.
comments.import:dry: Preview the CSV→schema mapping without writing to Convex.
comments.convex:dev: Create / push the NEW dedicated Convex DB from convex/ (writes CONVEX_URL you paste into .env.local).
comments.convex:deploy: Push convex/ functions + schema to the production deployment.
